quandoUsar: Galleries of templates, recipes, or integrations where each card opens its own details without changing pages.
Catalogs where the card summary (`summary`) is enough to choose and the full content (`content`) only appears in the modal, with actions in the footer.
Grids where continuity matters: icon and title travel from the card to the modal header.
quandoEvitar: Use `dialog` for a confirmation or form that does not originate from a card in a grid.
Use `expandable-card` when the details fit in the card itself and the page does not need to be blocked.
Use `image-viewer` for photo galleries with zoom and navigation between images.

teclado.acao: On the focused card, opens the modal.
Move through the modal controls without leaving it; on open, focus goes to the first control, the close button.
Closes the modal; focus returns to the card that opened it.

acessibilidade: Each card is a `<button>` with `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-expanded`; the modal is a Radix dialog with the title as its name and the `subtitle` as its description.
With the modal open, focus is trapped in it and the rest of the page leaves the accessibility tree; on close, focus returns to the originating card.
The close button is named “Close”, fixed in English in the code; the card media is hidden from the screen reader.
movimento: The card's box, media, and title are the same elements as the modal's and travel to the center on a spring with a slight bounce; on close, they return on a spring without bounce.
The summary disappears while subtitle, body, and footer arrive one after another, rising 12 px out of a slight blur, and all leave at once.
With “reduce motion” on, there is no shared travel: the modal only fades on enter and exit.
responsivo: The grid uses `auto-fill` with columns of at least `minColumnWidth` (default 220 px) and loses columns as the width shrinks.
The modal takes the screen width minus 2rem up to `width` (default 480 px), with a maximum height of `100dvh` minus 2rem and inner scrolling.
notasIA: Each item has `id`, `title`, and `content`; `summary` and `meta` only appear on the card, and `subtitle` and `media` appear on both.
Use `renderFooter(item, close)` for the actions and call `close()` after acting; to control the open card, use `value` (an `id` or `null`) with `onValueChange`.
Import `CenterMorphModal` from `@/components/ryan-ui/center-morph-modal/center-morph-modal`; it draws the whole grid, so pass all the cards at once.
